invariants.title: Her side on the left, his on the right
invariants.rule: Terra and the esper are on the LEFT of the screen, the jester on the RIGHT, for the whole shot.
invariants.why: one line of action for the film: every camera stands east of the line between them

invariants.title: Facing
invariants.rule: Terra faces screen-right (toward him); the esper faces screen-right (toward him); the jester faces screen-left (toward her), as the set's frames draw them.
invariants.why: a take keeps the facing its two frames give it; the duel's were mirrored by a bug

invariants.title: It starts where the last shot ended
invariants.rule: Terra starts where 100 left her; the jester starts where 080 left him.
invariants.why: a relay: each leg takes the moment from the one before

invariants.title: Its leg of the relay: echo
invariants.rule: The same moment again from another angle - story time 24 to 28 s.
invariants.why: LTX_PLAYBOOK §101: every shot is a leg of one moment; an echo repeats time already told

invariants.title: The same rising, from his side
invariants.rule: Him small in the foreground on the RIGHT, seen from behind; across the clearing she is small before the giant.

invariants.title: Length
invariants.why: each leg's length is its share of the story time

flair.title: Seed
flair.note: free - the takes differ by seed

flair.title: Timing inside the shot
flair.note: the beats may land a few frames early or late

flair.title: How far the place has burned
flair.note: the dress for this shot: red (dusk, red, burning, volcanic - it only ever gets worse)

flair.title: Sound
flair.note: H3's own: a deep roar of fire, a rumbling growl.

title: it rises - his side
beat: The same rising as 100, from his side of the clearing: how big it is to him. [echo · story t 24-28 s] (shot 11 of 23)
build: frames first in the clearing set (set_test.py render + cast --ends), H3 between the set's two frames (set_film.py takes) - the camera, the marks and the facing come from the set; the place's state from the shot's dress
